Game Overview

Mini Colors is a puzzle title where guide two star-crossed slimes across vibrant dimensions in Mini Colors. Use gravity-defying maneuvers to reunite these lovable creatures, mastering intricately crafted puzzles that require precision and strategy. Traverse through cleverly designed levels, dodging hazards and switching platforms, in this delightful, heartwarming adventure.
